{{Quote|Finally! We now know his whereabouts. He has been moved to a Corellian corvette within deep space. I need an Imperial soldier I can trust to go there and rescue the doctor. Ah...You! You are that soldier. Take this item to the shuttle pilot at the Emperor's Retreat. He will help you to intercept the Corellian corvette with Dr. Bledsoe.|[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darkstone]], to an Imperial soldier|<ref name="SWG:CD">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Colonel Darkstone"}}</ref>}}
The '''Mission to Rescue Doctor Bledsoe''' was a mission tasked by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darkstone]] to rescue [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Bledsoe]] from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SWG:CC" />

{{Mission-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Corellian Corvette instance appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Corellian Corvette was added to the game with the release of an [[W:c:swg:Update Notes: 13 April 04|update]] on [[April 13]], [[2004]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 7: Droid Invasion">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=61441|text=Publish 7: Droid Invasion}}</ref>
